content_zh:
汐妃是外邦进贡给大齐皇帝的舞姬，因美貌惊人，被皇帝收为嫔，产子后，又抬为妃。
按照原文中的描述，大齐虽然对邦国的态度比较宽容，但却不会容许混有外族血统的人继承皇位，所以，宁王虽得盛宠，却始终能够夹缝中求生存，没成为六位哥哥夺位的靶子。
而汐妃呢，作为龙傲天的母亲，她照理说该是个温柔大度的人，绝对不会因为儿子的玩具被摔了，就用刑报复薛遥这样的八岁孩子。
原文中对汐妃的性格描写并不多，大体印象就是个与世无争的小仙女。
关于她的剧情，主要都是描写她有多漂亮，以至于皇帝驾崩后，宁王去了封地，居然不断听说宫里有人打他亲妈汐妃的主意。
这也是宁王最终忍无可忍，挥师北上的催化剂之一。
所以，薛遥心理有准备，这次去青穹殿，若是能得见汐妃，不论她多漂亮，自己都不能看傻眼，最好眼睛都不要抬，不能给宁王记仇的机会，以为他觊觎汐妃美色。
“你这话说得也忒天真了。”青河不买账：“你那天羞辱七皇子，皇上让咱们上门道歉，那就是给汐妃动私刑的机会，她能放过咱们吗？”
薛遥心里有些郁闷。
他算是发现了，这本龙傲天小说，虽然故事情节为了爽而毫无逻辑，看的时候，觉得反派都没什么脑子，但实际上，书中没涉及到的情节，世界都是正常运转的，炮灰也是智商正常的人。
薛遥也是普通人，并不能靠智商吊打书里的普通人。
就说这侍读青河，看起来也不过十二三岁模样，言谈举止和心机，已经比薛遥自己十二三岁的时候成熟得多了。
刚刚那句“你那天羞辱七皇子”，轻描淡写的，就把锅全扣薛遥头上了！
薛遥当然不认，脸色不大好地开口：“那天的事，就算是我最先提议的，但若没你们的迎合撺掇，也成不了事。”
青河脸色一变，捶胸顿足：“我也不知当时吃了什么迷魂药！居然敢在七皇子头上动土，回想起来……唉！说到底，还是你挑的头！”
他一咬牙一跺脚，用裹着纱布的手一指薛遥，怒道：“一人做事一人当！我替你挨了一顿板子，再吃不消下一顿了，这趟青穹殿，你就自个儿走一趟罢！”
薛遥哭笑不得，尤其是他那句“不知吃了什么迷魂药”。
还不是作者为了打脸剧情，强行给你们这些炮灰降智商？
青河看他不说话，脸上笑容诡异，害怕他鱼死网破，立即又软了语气，抱着受伤的手哀叹道：“主要是我这嘴笨得很，跟你一起去，非但不能帮忙，还可能添……”
“好了。”薛遥打断他的话，笑到：“哥哥的意思我明白了，祸是咱们一起闯的，一人担一次责任，也公平，道歉的事，小弟一个人去办就是了。”

带着青河一起去，确实可能惹麻烦，再早熟，也还是个孩子，不如他一个人上门妥当。
但是，话还得说明白，薛遥故意强调“祸是咱们一起闯的”，这回，他一个人承担道歉的任务，算是两清，别想再拿挨板子的人情来压他。
青河一听，连忙缓和脸色，故作担忧道：“那这次就辛苦你了。”
薛遥说：“辛苦谈不上，只是我空着手上门道歉，实在没什么把握，如果不留个后手，这趟就算白挨一次打，你我五日后也要被取消侍读资格。”
青河心里还琢磨躲过一顿板子，没想到这年幼的遥哥儿已经想到了下一层，不由佩服道：“还是弟弟想得周全，若是要送礼，咱哥几个当然应该合力而为，至少送上一份娘娘看得过眼的玩意。”
薛遥摆手道：“汐妃娘娘日日得皇上的赏赐，咱们哪里凑得出她能看得上的礼物？不如对症下药，我的想法，就是直接给七皇子保证：三日内，修复玩具木马，原样奉还！外带送一只小玩意奉上，这一关，或许能过。”
青河眼睛一亮，这才想到，哄年幼的七皇子，肯定比哄汐妃容易得多，只要小皇子满意了，这笔账自然就勾销了。
修复木马无疑是最省钱省力的办法，想到这里，忍不住要夸薛遥。

content_en:
Concubine Xi was a dancing princess who was paid tribute by foreign countries to the Emperor of Da Qi. Because of her amazing beauty, she was accepted as a concubine by the emperor. After giving birth to a son, she was promoted to a concubine.
According to the description in the original text, although Da Qi has a relatively tolerant attitude towards the states, it will not allow people with foreign blood to inherit the throne. Therefore, although King Ning is favored, he has always been able to survive in the cracks and has not become a target for his six brothers to seize the throne.
As for Concubine Xi, as Long Aotian's mother, she was supposed to be a gentle and generous person. She would never use torture to retaliate against an eight-year-old child like Xue Yao just because her son's toy was thrown.
There is not much description of Concubine Xi's character in the original text, and the general impression is that she is a little fairy who lives aloof from the world.
The plot about her mainly describes how beautiful she is, so much so that after the emperor died, Prince Ning went to the fiefdom, and he kept hearing that someone in the palace was interested in his own mother, Concubine Xi.
This was also one of the catalysts for King Ning to finally have enough patience and send his troops northward.
Therefore, Xue Yao was mentally prepared. If he could see Concubine Xi when he went to Qingqiong Palace this time, no matter how beautiful she was, he could not be dumbfounded. It was best not to raise his eyes, so as not to give Prince Ning a chance to hold grudges, thinking that he coveted Concubine Xi's beauty.
"What you said is so naive." Qing He didn't buy it: "You humiliated the Seventh Prince that day, and the Emperor asked us to come and apologize. That was an opportunity for Concubine Xi to be lynched. Can she let us go?"
Xue Yao felt a little depressed.
He finally discovered that although the plot of Long Aotian's novel was illogical for the sake of entertainment, and when he read it, he felt that the villains had no brains, but in fact, in the plots not covered in the book, the world was functioning normally, and the cannon fodder was also a person with normal IQ.
Xue Yao is also an ordinary person, and he cannot defeat ordinary people in books by relying on his IQ.
Let's just say that Qinghe, the attendant, only looks about 12 or 13 years old. His speech, behavior and scheming are already much more mature than when Xue Yao himself was 12 or 13 years old.
The sentence "You humiliated the Seventh Prince that day" was an understatement and put all the blame on Xue Yao!
Of course Xue Yao didn't recognize it, and said with a grim expression: "What happened that day, even if I was the first to propose it, it wouldn't have happened without your pandering and instigation."
Qinghe's expression changed, and he beat his chest: "I don't know what kind of ecstasy drug I took at that time! I dared to stir up trouble on the seventh prince's head. Looking back... Oh! In the end, it was you who took the initiative!"
He gritted his teeth and stomped his feet, pointed at Xue Yao with his gauze-wrapped hand, and said angrily: "Everyone is responsible for the work! I took a beating for you, and I can't bear the next one. This trip to Qingqiong Palace, you just go to Qingqiong Palace by yourself!"
Xue Yao couldn't laugh or cry, especially his sentence "I don't know what kind of ecstasy I took".
Didn't the author forcefully lower the IQ of you cannon fodder just to slap the plot in the face?
Seeing that he didn't speak, Qinghe had a weird smile on his face. He was afraid that he would be defeated, so he immediately softened his tone, hugged his injured hand and lamented: "The main reason is that I am very stupid. If I go with you, not only will I not be able to help, but I may also cause..."
"Okay." Xue Yao interrupted him and smiled: "I understand what brother means. We all caused the disaster together. It is only fair that one person takes the responsibility once. I can handle the apology alone."
Taking Qinghe with him might indeed cause trouble. No matter how precocious he is, he is still a child, so it would be better for him to come alone.
However, the words had to be explained clearly. Xue Yao deliberately emphasized that "we all caused the disaster together." This time, he took on the task of apologizing alone, so he was clear of both sides. Don't try to pressure him with any favors.
When Qinghe heard this, he quickly softened his expression and pretended to be worried: "Then I'll have to work hard for you this time."
Xue Yao said: "It's hard work, but I came here empty-handed to apologize. I really don't have any confidence. If I don't leave a backup plan, this trip will be in vain, and you and I will be disqualified from attending school in five days."
Qinghe was still thinking about avoiding itAfter a while, I didn't expect that the young brother Yao had already thought of the next level. He couldn't help but admire him: "My brother is more thoughtful. If you want to give a gift, of course we brothers should work together to at least give something that the queen can see."
Xue Yao waved his hand and said: "Concubine Xi is getting rewards from the emperor every day, how can we get a gift that she can appreciate? Why don't we give her the right remedy? My idea is to directly guarantee to the seventh prince: within three days, the toy Trojan horse will be repaired and returned to its original state! I will give you a small gadget as a takeaway. Maybe I can pass this test."
Qinghe's eyes lit up, and then he thought that it would be much easier to coax the young seventh prince than to coax Concubine Xi. As long as the young prince is satisfied, the account will naturally be written off.
Repairing the Trojan is undoubtedly the most cost-effective and labor-saving way. Thinking of this, I can't help but praise Xue Yao.
